description: This source file defines an enum 'GatewayPushSubscription' with static methods for subscribing to push notifications and managing a task for push consumption, using async/await and MainActor annotations.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to push notifications stream and invokes 'onPush' callback for each received GatewayPush, respecting task cancellation and executing on the main actor.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Cancels the existing task if any, then creates and starts a new Task to consume push notifications and invoke callback.
